---
title: "International Partnerships"
---

International cooperation is central to ÇAHSPAR’s research mission. We seek lasting partnerships with associations specialising in labour and social policy, universities, research institutes, professional networks, social partners and civil society organisations across the world.

## Our Partnership Agenda

- Develop comparative studies and international research consortia
- Prepare joint project proposals and co-authored publications
- Organise international conferences, workshops and methodological exchanges
- Support mentoring and collaboration across career stages and regions
- Share and critically discuss publications from international organisations and research networks
- Connect researchers in Türkiye with international scholarship through reciprocal knowledge exchange

## Cooperation Across Regions

The ILO’s five broad geographical regions provide a reference for developing a geographically diverse network: Africa, Americas, Arab States, Asia and the Pacific, and Europe and Central Asia. We aim to build partnerships around shared research questions, complementary expertise and equitable participation.

References to international organisations describe our research interests and sources of knowledge; formal partnerships will be identified through specific activities and agreements.

## Current Partnerships

**18 October 2026**

### [ESD Conference – Ankara, 29–30 May 2027](https://www.esd-conference.com/)

Preparations have begun for the international conference “Sustainable Societies and Social Policy: Pathways for Just and Inclusive Futures”, to be held in Ankara on 29–30 May 2027 as part of the ESD Conference (International Scientific Conference Economic and Social Development) series and the association’s international partnerships. The conference proceedings are to be indexed in Web of Science (WoS). Further details will be shared shortly.
